description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_AppendByRef, which implements a method for appending values by reference to Smarty template variables within the Smarty template engine. It includes a static method appendByRef that performs the appending operation, handling reference behaviors and scope updates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_AppendByRef
classes.description: Class providing a static method to append values by reference to a Smarty template variable within the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: appendByRef
methods.description: Static method to append a referenced value to a Smarty template variable, with optional merge behavior and scope update.
